title: Sean McVay has no timeline for Myles Garrett's return after knee surgery, defends playing him in Week 1 loss to 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay has no timeline for Myles Garrett's return after knee surgery, defends playing him in Week 1 loss to 49ers
sources.description: Myles Garrett didn't have a single tackle in the Rams' loss to the 49ers last week, and is now headed for knee surgery.
